named_fixes.old: Investopedia reports a large fund likely to increase Nvidia exposure while reducing Apple. That is anticipated allocation demand, not a completed flow total. [[n1218]] The event trade weakens if the shares cannot retain support once that expected buying is absorbed. A status milestone can sustain attention while leaving less incremental news to arrive. Demand from an adjustment has a lifecycle, and the business must provide a reason to hold after it. Keep the exit tied to the catalyst rather than the prestige of the label.
